config.scope: Released-code replication on reconstructed Goodfire manifold zoo; bounded configuration sweep, not exact published-result replication.
config.schedule: Released trainer Adam/OneCycleLR; clean synthetic inputs

recipe.initialization: Training mixture second moments conditional on factor presence; no true component vectors used for initialization.
recipe.guidance: Known component reconstruction, equally averaged over active instances within factor and then factors; balanced factor-presence BCE.
recipe.assignment: First128 groups fixed to128 known factors; reserve groups remain unlabelled.
recipe.selection: Minimum selection-set reconstruction MSE over logged checkpoints and two learning rates, before opening synthetic test.
recipe.final_endpoint: Final200-epoch endpoint of the same selected learning-rate trial is a separate diagnostic.
recipe.scope: Factor-supervised synthetic analogue; stronger labels than COCO object masks. No guarantee of perfect learned recovery.
